=========================================================================
HANDOFF #2 — /rebar-implement on epic e369 (adroit-deductible-kakapo). READ FIRST.
=========================================================================

## Board

EPIC e369 in_progress. 6 of 8 stories done or in review:
  J1 acb2 CLOSED+MERGED | J2 62d9 CLOSED+MERGED | J4 0a94 CLOSED+MERGED
  J3 aac8 CLOSED+MERGED | J5 c97f CLOSED+MERGED
  J6 9fd4 IN_PROGRESS — implemented, validated, pushed as change 1049, GATES STILL RUNNING
  J7 b4e3 OPEN — assemble JiraDataCenterBackend + hold it to the backend-agnostic contract suite
  J8 8c35 OPEN — the ADR amending 0035
J7's blocker is J6; J8's is J7. Neither is claimable until its predecessor closes.

## Where the code is

Worktree /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-jira-family, branch jira-family-seam.
HEAD = J6's commit on top of origin/main f6062209d. Working tree CLEAN (all J6 work is committed).
main already carries J1-J5: the jira_family shared layer, UserIdentityModel, RichTextCodec, and the
Dockerized DC harness. Nine changes merged this session (1010, 1011, 1013, 1015, 1019, 1020, 1026, 1027, and
J1's 1009 from the prior session).

## IMMEDIATE NEXT ACTIONS

 1. Poll change 1049 (J6). Use the PATCHSET-AWARE poller — a plain label read returns STALE votes and will
    lie to you. Script: /Users/joeoakhart/.claude/jobs/<job>/tmp/poll_ps.sh, or replicate: accept a vote only
    when its message _revision_number == the current revision.
 2. When 1049 is green: submit it, fast-forward the worktree, then close J6.
    EXPECT the close to need retries — see the d59e note below.
 3. Then J7 b4e3: review-plan -> claim -> held-out TDD -> push -> close. J7 is where the DC work is finally
    exercised as a PEER of Cloud through tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_backend_contract.py, rather than as
    a separate path. Its AC requires the contract suite's backend fixture to include 'jira-datacenter'.
 4. Then J8 8c35 (ADR — a non-code leaf; no review change needed for the doc itself per the skill, but this
    repo lands docs through Gerrit like everything else).
 5. Then close the EPIC. Nothing is left un-landed: this session used the early-land exception, so every
    merged change is already on main. There is NO parked stack to submit at the end.

## GOTCHAS THAT COST ME TIME — read before repeating them

 * A same-tree 'git commit --amend --no-edit' does NOT re-trigger the LLM review: Gerrit COPIES the votes
   ('same tree ... Copied Votes'). A coverage-gap -1 needs a REAL tree change. 'recheck' re-runs CI ONLY.
 * 'git commit --amend -F <file>' REGENERATES the Change-Id unless the message already contains it. This
   orphaned change 1008 in the prior session. Always diff trailers before pushing.
 * A blank line between trailers splits the block so %(trailers) drops rebar-ticket. Keep them contiguous.
 * After Gerrit submits, your branch may not fast-forward — Gerrit REBASES on submit, so the merged SHA
   differs from your local commit. Verify YOUR FILE landed (diff that path against origin/main) before
   discarding local work; comparing whole trees is misleading because other people's commits are in between.
 * FETCH BEFORE YOU BASELINE. I triaged two failures as 'pre-existing on main' correctly, but main was 7
   commits ahead and had already FIXED them (6526cfeae). Stale baselines produce true-but-useless verdicts.
 * VERIFY A MUTATION ACTUALLY APPLIED. Two of mine were silent no-ops that 'passed' and proved nothing. One
   was caught only by noticing the run took 0.47s when a real retry costs 7s of backoff.
 * THE MODULE-SIZE CAP BIT THREE TIMES. transition_close.py (791->829) and _config_schema.py (797->861) were
   each a few lines under 800 before an otherwise-correct change. CHECK 'find src/rebar -name "*.py" -exec
   wc -l {} + | awk $1>800' BEFORE pushing. And per the operator's standing instruction: when you must
   split, justify it by COHESION and name the seam — never by LOC pressure.
 * Do not read a test suite whose files changed mid-run, and do not run an emulated JVM beside it (this repo
   has wall-clock-sensitive tests). I killed one 30-minute run for the first and stopped a container for the second.

## d59e — the close gate WILL block you, and it is a known bug

'rebar transition <id> in_progress closed' can abort with 'completion recovery context bound exceeded' and
falsely tell you to install the agents extra. Root-caused (see d59e): recovery is entered ONLY when the
PRIMARY verifier truncates, which is a property of the live call — so RETRYING OFTEN SUCCEEDS. That is how
c97f was closed. The misleading message is fixed on main (change 1027); the underlying 'oversized ticket
cannot use recovery' is INTENDED behaviour and left as a design decision.
Also: editing a ticket's description STALES its plan attestation, so the close gate then demands a fresh
review-plan. Budget ~15-20 min for that if you edit an AC.

## Tickets filed this session (all with file_impact + provenance links)

 65d7 task OPEN  — _assignee_resolver injected by attribute + getattr, silent non-authoritative fallback.
                   discovered_from J4. Needs the neutral port signature to change, so wider than J4's scope.
 2bc7 bug  OPEN  — test helpers sys.modules.setdefault but RETURN the new module; five files race on the
                   'mutation' key. CAUSED J4's macos-py3.13 Verified -1. Fixed inside J4 and disclosed there;
                   this ticket carries the follow-ups (one shared conftest loader; audit other by-path keys).
 d59e bug  IN_PROGRESS — messaging fix MERGED (1027); remaining scope recorded in its own comment. Claimed by
                   RebarBotNava; release or continue as you prefer.
 8070 bug  OPEN  — external-integration weekly canary RED since 2026-07-14 (SnapshotRefError on HEAD, ~7 live
                   tests, 35 occurrences in one cron). NOT caused by this epic — proven by job-level
                   comparison: the DC harness job added 07-30 PASSES, the two failing jobs failed on the
                   07-20 and 07-27 crons before it existed.

## Verification assets J7/J8 inherit

 * The DC harness is REAL and green on CI: dispatch external-integration.yml on main; the 'jira DC harness
   smoke' job builds, boots (~3-8 min), runs 4 smoke tests, tears down. ubuntu-latest is native amd64 — an
   Apple-Silicon workstation CANNOT run it (three measured attempts; emulation, not config).
 * tests/_jira_shape_contract.py is the verified-fake honesty contract now holding Cloud fake, Cloud real AND
   the DC transport to ONE definition of the payload shapes. J7 should extend that pattern, not fork it.
 * tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_harness_shape.py enforces the harness's file shape on EVERY
   commit (digest pin, both mandatory AMPS flags, loopback bind, no integration marker) — mutation-verified.
